get.description: Lets the UI show whether a key is configured before anyone types.

post.description: Body: the AI SDK chat request plus `threadId`. Streams the reply.

ChartSpec.title: ChartSpec
ChartSpec.description: How to draw the result. Empty fields are filled from the query (x = first dimension, y = measures).

ColumnInfo.title: ColumnInfo
ColumnInfo.description: A column in a widget's result rows.

DatasetInfo.title: DatasetInfo
DatasetInfo.description: A dataset the builder and the assistant can query.

DimensionInfo.title: DimensionInfo
DimensionInfo.description: A field you can group or filter by.

DimensionRef.title: DimensionRef
DimensionRef.description: A dimension to group by. `grain` buckets a temporal field (e.g. by month).

Filter.title: Filter
Filter.description: A condition on a dimension; `relative` periods like "last_week" are resolved when the query runs.

ItemPublic.title: ItemPublic
ItemPublic.description: An item as returned by the API.

ItemUpdate.title: ItemUpdate
ItemUpdate.description: Every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.

MeasureInfo.title: MeasureInfo
MeasureInfo.description: An aggregate you can chart (a sum, count or average).

PlotlyFigure.title: PlotlyFigure
PlotlyFigure.description: A Plotly figure as JSON (the same shape as `fig.to_json()`).

QuerySpec.title: QuerySpec
QuerySpec.description: What to fetch. With measures, rows are grouped by the dimensions; without, raw rows are returned.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation
Recommendation.description: Which chart suits the result best, and whether the requested one can be drawn.

SortBy.title: SortBy
SortBy.description: Sort by a dimension or measure in the query.

ThreadMessages.title: ThreadMessages
ThreadMessages.description: A thread's messages in the Vercel AI SDK `UIMessage` shape.

ThreadPublic.title: ThreadPublic
ThreadPublic.description: A chat thread, without its messages.

WidgetCreate.title: WidgetCreate
WidgetCreate.description: A new widget; without a position it goes below the existing ones.

WidgetPosition.title: WidgetPosition
WidgetPosition.description: A widget's place on the 12-column grid.

WidgetPublic.title: WidgetPublic
WidgetPublic.description: A widget and where it sits on the grid.

WidgetResult.title: WidgetResult
WidgetResult.description: A widget's data and figure. `chart_type` is what was drawn (the recommendation if the request was infeasible).

WidgetSpec.title: WidgetSpec
WidgetSpec.description: A query plus how to chart it: everything needed to redraw a widget with fresh data.

WidgetUpdate.title: WidgetUpdate
WidgetUpdate.description: Only the fields you send are changed.
